desc: Prove the exact reachability characterization for labeled particles, including the minimum operation count for a fixed assignment.
Formulate fixed-\(K\) feasibility using sorted 1-positions of \(A\) and \(B\), requiring every target 1-position to be used.
Develop and prove an \(O(N)\) greedy/scan feasibility checker for duplicate assignments and the displacement constraints.
Verify the characterization and checker on collisions, one target, equal piece counts, and impossible cases.
Combine the checker with an efficient optimization/search method and provide the final implementation.
